name: beat-recognizer
description: Real-time and offline music beat/tempo recognition, compiled to WASM. TypeScript-callable, browser-native, no server dependency.

scripts.build:wasm: cd .. && wasm-pack build crates/beat-wasm --target web --out-dir ../../ts/wasm --out-name beat_wasm
scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:ts
